title: Store documents in "our vector database"
prompt: Build a pipeline that stores our company documents in our vector database so we can search them later.

followups.text: We use Qdrant Cloud. Host and API key are in Variables as ROCKETRIDE_QDRANT_HOST and ROCKETRIDE_QDRANT_KEY, collection company-docs. Use OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, I'll upload files with a dropper, and call it company-docs.
Yes, approved: use those components and that wiring and build it. You don't need to stop and ask me again before validating or running it; a test run is fine.

checks.note: no successful write_file, edit_file, rename, delete_file or create_app in turn 1

checks.blocker_name: file outside the task folder changed

judge.question: Does the assistant ask which vector database the user already uses (or where it is hosted and how to connect)? A question only about approving a node list or topology does not count.

reference.note: the state after the follow-up answer

hard_because: "Our vector database" names a fact only the user has. The managed rocketride_vector node needs no settings, so a model can guess it and look helpful. The building skill also makes the model ask gate questions; the judge must tell a gate question from the question that matters.
